mapper.select: SELECT u.* FROM user u INNER JOIN course_student cs ON u.id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.course_id = #{courseId} AND u.role = 'student'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user(username, password, real_name, role, student_no, phone, email, class_name, status) VALUES(#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{role}, #{studentNo}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{className}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET face_registered = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
